global._comment_gradient: gradientConfig defines canonical structure; all themes get same gradient fields. Per-theme configs only allow raw overrides (overrides.*), not gradient structure.

zero.description: Zero spacing - removes all spacing, used for resetting margins/padding

pico.description: Minimal spacing - hairline gaps, subtle borders, pixel-perfect adjustments

nano.description: Nano spacing - minimal gaps, tight icon spacing, subtle borders

micro.description: Micro spacing - compact padding, small gaps between related elements

extraSmall.description: Extra small spacing - standard padding for compact components

small.description: Small spacing - comfortable padding for small components, form field spacing

medium.description: Medium spacing - default padding for most components, standard gap between elements

large.description: Large spacing - generous padding, section spacing, larger gaps

extraLarge.description: Extra large spacing - substantial padding, major section gaps, card spacing

mega.description: Mega spacing - large component padding, significant section separation

giga.description: Giga spacing - generous padding, section spacing

tera.description: Tera spacing - enormous padding, hero section spacing, major page divisions

peta.description: Peta spacing - maximum layout spacing, full-page hero sections, extreme layouts

dimension._comment_semanticByVariant: Optional per-variant overrides. Keys: variant names (e.g. minor, normal, major). Missing variants use dimension.semantic above.
dimension._comment_outputUnit: Per-platform output unit for dimension tokens. CSS uses rem for responsive/accessible design; JSON/JS stay px for Figma/Tokens Studio compatibility. Set css to 'px' to revert.
dimension._comment_pxOnly: Token types and paths that remain in px regardless of outputUnit. Note: tokens that reference dimension/sizing aliases (e.g. borderWidth -> sizing.pico) inherit rem through the reference chain. Only tokens with raw numeric values (like depth.spread) are effectively excluded.

typography._comment_lineHeight: Set customLineHeight to true and edit lineHeightSemantics to override default line-height ratios. Values in percentage (100 = 1, 120 = 1.2, etc.). Formula: lineHeight_px = ROUNDUP(fontSize * (value/100) / layoutUnit) * layoutUnit.
typography._comment_fontSizeScaleRatio: Ratio for font size growth/reduction (like typescale.com). Base = defaultDesignUnit per dimension variant; sizes = base × ratio^exponent. Examples: 1.067 Minor Second, 1.125 Major Second, 1.2 Minor Third (default), 1.25 Major Third, 1.333 Perfect Fourth, 1.414 Augmented Fourth, 1.5 Perfect Fifth, 1.618 Golden Ratio.
typography._comment_fontSizeScale: Optional. Array of font size keys (e.g. micro, extraSmall, small, medium, large, extraLarge, mega, giga, tera, peta, exa). When set, overrides the scale from schemas/typography-scale.mjs. Theme fontSizes override must then include exactly these keys.

global._comment_opacityScale: Optional. Per-step opacity 0-100 (percent) for semantic.opacity.raw and surface.opacity rgba stubs (dark/light). Omitted keys keep defaults. Run npm run sync:architecture after changes.
